title: Remembering Unequally: Global and Disciplinary Bias in LLM Reconstruction of Scholarly Coauthor Lists

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy of LLM-generated coauthor lists, measured via Discoverable Name Extraction (DNE) scores, between highly cited researchers and low-cited researchers.
Evaluating disparities in the memorization and accurate reconstruction of coauthor lists (DNE scores) across 10 different academic fields of science.
Analyzing differences in Discoverable Name Extraction (DNE) scores for researchers affiliated with institutions across 8 distinct global regions.
